intent: A playable, stylized Milan Duomo-inspired arena built as a forest of polystyle pillars, not an engineering reconstruction.
knownLimitations: The source image is a historical raster plan, not CAD.
The ceiling/vaults are intentionally absent for now.
The plan rhythm is compressed and scaled for gameplay readability.
The visual goal is cathedral-like spatial rhythm: vertical shafts, aisles, wall piers, and apse compression.

structure.mainExperience: Move through a repeated nave grid of tall clustered pillars.
structure.nave: Four interior rows create five aisle bands.
structure.transept: A wider horizontal bay breaks the longitudinal rhythm.
structure.choir: The pillar grid continues toward a narrowed apse.
structure.walls: Low perimeter and engaged piers suggest the cathedral envelope without enclosing every historical wall.

materials.secondary: aged dark stone in wall bases and pier shadows
materials.floor: large pale marble slabs with subtle tint variation
materials.lighting: cool daylight from above with warm bounce and light fog

gameplay.spacingCorrection: The first playable pass deliberately compresses the real building, but preserves the important ratio: wide central nave spacing, side aisles roughly half as wide, and pillar bases no longer visually crowding the player.

referenceDimensions.source: Veneranda Fabbrica del Duomo di Milano / Google Arts & Culture story on the central nave

gameplay.collision: Freestanding pillars use simple collision boxes; decorative wall piers and small floor details are non-blocking unless part of perimeter walls.
gameplay.targetVisibility: Long aisles remain clear enough for target visibility and shooting.
gameplay.spawn: Near the west entrance centerline, looking into the pillar forest.
